name: helios
description: Physically-based Monte Carlo path tracer in TypeScript with zero runtime dependencies, deterministic PNG output, and a physics-validated test suite

scripts.render:all: npm run build && node dist/cli.js render scenes/cornell.json --out renders/cornell.png && node dist/cli.js render scenes/spheres.json --out renders/spheres.png && node dist/cli.js render scenes/night.json --out renders/night.png
